title: Kiritani Haruka — Unbeatable Coordination!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Here goes... There!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Failed again...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If we include all the times we tried during the lunch break, that was our hundredth time... Making a challenge video is even tougher than I expected.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Rolling the same number on six dice... It's easier said than done since the odds are so low.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Just how low are the odds, about?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's see... Since there are six dice, we put in six to the power of six as the denominator, and the numerator would be six...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If we roll 7,776 times, we can expect to get it once...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: S-Seven thousand?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
A-Alright!
I'm gonna pretend I didn't hear that! One more time...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh... Sorry.
I have things to do for MORE MORE JUMP! today, so I need to be going soon.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh. It's almost time for our practice too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, it's already that time?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I guess we'll pick this back up tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Sorry, guys...
I didn't mean to take up so much of your time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This might be a little too difficult, so maybe we should try it with fewer dice tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No...
The odds aren't zero, so we're sure to do it if we keep trying.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's right. Let's be patient and persevere!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But... At this rate, it could take us days and days, y'know?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe, that's fine.
We'll stick with you until it happens, no matter how many hundreds or thousands of rolls it takes.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. Let's make it happen.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I love you guys!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, let's do our best again tomorrow!
The next day - Lunch break

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?! Ichi, you're eating an egg sandwich!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Were they out of yakisoba buns?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, they still had yakisoba buns, but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: According to my fortune for today, yellow is my lucky color. So, I wanted to give our luck any boost I could to help us with the challenge video...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm gonna pick up trash in the classroom to boost my luck with good deeds!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Um, in that case... Maybe I'll help the girl on classroom duty clean the blackboard.
After school

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, this time...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wh-Whoa...!
We got five ones! They're matching!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But the last one...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It landed up against the pencil case and isn't facing straight up...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, Haruka, close your eyes for juuust a second!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Blow*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! You can open them now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
They're all ones, but...
Hehe. Saki, isn't that cheating?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Nooo worries!
I didn't use my hands, so it's all good!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see. Then we'll call this a success, so...

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Saki & Ichika
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Around how many times did we end up rolling...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: About two hundred.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We rolled that many times?!
Thank you both so much for sticking with me!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
And thank you for inviting me.
All that excitement and goofing around was a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The validity of our success is kind of questionable, though.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Saki & Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Hahaha.
